# A slice that is stored and also read at an offset is vectorized only when no
# iteration reads what an earlier one wrote: a forward loop that reads at a constant
# positive offset (see offset_stored.txt). A recurrence (a[i] = a[i-1] + b[i])
# carries a value from one iteration to the next, so it is rejected with its own
# reason. A distance that is not a constant and a loop that counts down have no
# order loopvec can check.
# Offsets that are not the same on every iteration, a stride, and a store at an
# offset are left alone too.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Recurrence(a, b []int32) {
	for i := 1; i < len(a); i++ {
		a[i] = a[i-1] + b[i]
	}
}

func StoredDistanceUnknown(a, b []int32, k int) {
	for i := 0; i < len(a)-k; i++ {
		a[i] = a[i+k] + b[i]
	}
}

func StoredCountingDown(a, b []int32) {
	for i := len(a) - 2; i >= 0; i-- {
		a[i] = a[i+1] + b[i]
	}
}

func Strided(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst)/2; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[2*i]
	}
}

func OffsetFromSlice(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst); i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+int(b[0])]
	}
}

func OffsetAssigned(dst, a []int32, off int) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst); i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+off]
		off++
	}
}

func StoreAtOffset(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst)-1; i++ {
		dst[i+1] = a[i]
	}
}

func OffsetFromIndex(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst); i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+i]
	}
}
-- stdout.want --
